title: Teams
subtitle: Manage team workspaces, members, permissions, and organizational scope.

empty.title: No teams found
empty.description: Teams organize members, permissions, and key management per workspace.

detail.empty: Select a team to inspect its members, scope, and permissions.

create.title: Create team
create.description: Create a team with an optional organizational unit scope.

edit.title: Edit team
edit.description: Update the team identity, organizational scope, and workspace type.

delete.title: Delete team
delete.description: Deleting a team is blocked when active dependencies still exist.
delete.guardDescription: Delete is blocked when active keys, virtual users, or team members exist.

members.title: Manage members
members.description: Assign team roles and route-level permissions for team members.
members.userHelp: Only existing users who are not already members of this team are shown.
members.permissions: Member access to this team's keys
members.permissionsHelp: These permissions apply only to regular members in this team. Administrative roles follow RBAC.
members.teamAdminAccessDescription: Team admins receive access to all key operations in this team through their RBAC role and do not need separate permissions.

info.label: View key details
info.description: View a key's information and configuration

list.label: List keys
list.description: See keys that belong to this team

generate.label: Create keys
generate.description: Create a new key for this team

block.label: Block keys
block.description: Temporarily stop a key from being used

upgradeDialog.title: Team creation is not available on your plan
upgradeDialog.description: Creating and managing teams is not included in your current commercial plan. Upgrade your plan to use this feature.
